project.title: Native normalized company bootstrap and early upgrades
project.goal: Create the full company schema in native Rust and migrate known normalized early prefixes on private copies.
project.scope: R12 existing empty/normalized prefixes0–31; prior suffix32–36 contract preserved, full legacy normalization and writer gates unchanged.

component.storage.description: Own bounded private SQLite migration rehearsal.

boundary.responsibility: Capture, recover, validate, migrate and discard private copies.
boundary.rationale: Original writer admission is not yet complete.
excludes: Live migrations, domain writes and promotion

action.rehearse_company_physical.description: Explicit private unversioned known-layout physical baseline rehearsal

preconditions: Explicit local read authority; complete known baseline schema, all original columns, empty strict history; no original migration/adoption authority.
postconditions: Only known private copy changes; source unchanged and all private handles/files removed.
Original typed cells preserved except specified VAT relabel and baseline data effects; full schema/guards restored.
Atomic baseline1 includes data normalization and all guards; no writer/adoption authority.
external_effects: Read/stat source files; recover/migrate/delete private disposable files only.

idempotency.rationale: Repeated source rehearsal leaves original state unchanged; generated private identities/timestamps are separately qualified.

boundaries.rationale: Exact complete physical schema and empty history; VAT semantic conflicts refuse.

concurrency.rationale: Capture stable source while legacy reader/writer may be active.

atomicity.rationale: Real transactional rollback and process death.

action.rehearse_company_physical.behavior: Admit complete known physical baseline and empty history; atomic rebuild/preservation/guard/data/baseline stamp; pending versioned steps; full schema checks and private cleanup.

scenario.normal.description: Full typed-cell/DDL parity with actual TS migrate; only allowed VAT kind and data effects.

scenario.given: Complete known unversioned baseline with one of16 known constraint combinations and populated original rows.
scenario.when: Run physical rebuild then actual pending2–36.
scenario.then: Full typed-cell/DDL parity with actual TS migrate; only allowed VAT kind and data effects.

scenario.history.description: Refuse before mutations; never silently adopt provenance.

scenario.given: Nonempty/checksumless/incompatible history or unexplained physical shape.
scenario.then: Refuse before mutations; never silently adopt provenance.

scenario.checkpoint.description: Refuse before rebuild; no guessing or low-year Date.UTC compatibility claim.

scenario.given: VAT cadence mismatch, deregistered mixed cadences, duplicate windows, reported overlaps or low-year ambiguity.
scenario.when: Validate all relevant canonical/legacy VAT rows against company ID1.
scenario.then: Refuse before rebuild; no guessing or low-year Date.UTC compatibility claim.

scenario.isolation.description: Valid private recovery or typed refusal; unchanged source inventory and checked cleanup.

scenario.given: Known source, active WAL, missing/linked path or unusable private storage.
scenario.when: Capture with existing fixed-path private-copy mechanism.
scenario.then: Valid private recovery or typed refusal; unchanged source inventory and checked cleanup.

scenario.failure.description: Rollback every physical/data/history effect; no committed baseline1 without guards/data.

scenario.given: Real SQL/guard/invariant failure during physical or baseline data stage.
scenario.then: Rollback every physical/data/history effect; no committed baseline1 without guards/data.

scenario.crash.description: Complete old unversioned schema/data/history; retry succeeds.

scenario.given: Actual child paused after copy/drop/rename or baseline history insertion.
scenario.when: Kill/reap child and reopen disposable file.
scenario.then: Complete old unversioned schema/data/history; retry succeeds.

scenario.usage.description: Usage exit2; ordinary migration keeps explicit unversioned refusal.

scenario.given: Invalid/missing/duplicate flags or old ordinary command on populated unversioned source.
scenario.then: Usage exit2; ordinary migration keeps explicit unversioned refusal.

scenario.guards.description: New valid cases work; duplicate/immutable/invalid/fiscal changes refuse.

scenario.given: Completed native schema with GDPR subjects, customer terms, VAT periods and fiscal lock.
scenario.when: Insert different subject same source row/audit source; attempt duplicate same subject, updates/deletes, invalid terms and valid fiscal change after journal.
scenario.then: New valid cases work; duplicate/immutable/invalid/fiscal changes refuse.

scenario.repeat.description: Source remains unchanged; new private timestamps/UUIDs stay explicitly scoped.

scenario.then: Source remains unchanged; new private timestamps/UUIDs stay explicitly scoped.

scenario.concurrent.description: No partial baseline commit; source capture retains existing bounded concurrency contract.

scenario.given: Captured known baseline with all four rebuilds and baseline data.
scenario.when: Run one private immediate transaction before per-step pending migrations.
scenario.then: No partial baseline commit; source capture retains existing bounded concurrency contract.
